description: Structured data (schema.org) checker — Fetch a web page and audit its structured data: parses every JSON-LD block (incl. @graph), microdata itemtypes and RDFa, lists schema.org types found, checks required and recommended fields for 23 common types (Product offers price/currency/availability, Article, FAQPage questions, BreadcrumbList, Event, Recipe, JobPosting, LocalBusiness, VideoObject, Organization...), flags invalid JSON, and returns rich-result candidates plus a 0-100 score and A-F grade. Param: url (required). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).

url.description: Page URL to audit (http/https), e.g. https://www.example.com/product/1

name: web_schema
